verdict: Strong 4.93x return on ad spend with purchases trending up this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $6,875.65 in revenue on $1,393.99 in spend — a 4.93x return — and purchase volume rose 22% in the most recent 7 days compared to the prior 7, confirming that demand is real and holding. The lead count showing in the dashboard reads low, but this is a tracking gap, not a demand signal; purchases rising at the same time confirms buyers are coming through. Several backend milestones — including UTM tracking, subscribe pages, and automated flows — are being completed this week to close attribution gaps and give us a cleaner read on the full funnel going forward. Next period, with those pieces in place, you should expect more complete conversion data and the first steps of Tier 3 audience expansion on Meta.
